summary: Trust Layer is the umbrella evidence surface; the linked patterns provide its concrete analysis, review, validation and governance mechanisms.

items.text: Interpret accumulated evidence with Analysis Report loops that calibrate findings and create follow-up work; Trust Layer remains the shared surface that supplies and receives that evidence.
Use Fire, Track, Review as the human operating mode over trust evidence: inspect the artifact and its checks after the run instead of supervising the agent chat.
Generate named, structured pass, fail or advisory verdicts at delivery gates; Trust Layer aggregates and exposes those verdicts for review.
Extend the evidence stream with scheduled whole-system checks that catch drift and degradation outside an individual change.
Anchor model-generated evidence in deterministic builds, tests and checks that fail independently of a model's opinion.
Make the evidence independently reconstructible through platform-owned history and bounded agent authority rather than agent self-reporting.
Consume digest-bound evidence envelopes across runs; Run Trace defines the underlying task, attempt, event and artifact lineage plus safe replay levels.
